title: From GPT-3 to GPT-5: Mapping their capabilities, scope, limitations, and consequences

live_model.evidence: "We present the progress of the GPT family from GPT-3 through GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and the GPT-5 family" (a historical/comparative survey).

prompt.note: This is a narrative survey of the GPT model family's public documentation; no experiments are run.

notes: A qualitative history/comparison of GPT-3 through GPT-5 drawn from papers, model pages, release notes and system cards; GPT-4 Turbo (and every other model named) is discussed only descriptively, never run by the authors.
